description.value: Main Street Poke is a fast-casual bowl restaurant in Whistler serving fresh poke bowls, ramen, and rice bowls with a wide range of proteins, bases, and toppings including vegan options. The menu draws on the Hawaiian tradition of marinated fish bowls updated with West Coast and fusion flavours, and the business also offers catering for events. It's a popular quick-service stop in the village for hungry cyclists looking for a customizable, nourishing meal.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms an active restaurant at 112-4368 Main St, Whistler with online ordering, catering, and gift cards. Phone 604-962-1112 is listed in the ADDRESS & HOURS section of the contact page, matching the OSM tag. The website explicitly mentions vegan options ('our selection will indulge everyone, from fish lovers, to vegans') and the 'Order NOW' functionality confirms takeout is offered; no evidence was found for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or most other amenity fields.
concerns: Contact page shows 'Tel. ??? ??? ????' as a placeholder field that was never filled in, though the correct phone number (604-962-1112) does appear in the ADDRESS & HOURS section of the same page — minor website maintenance issue.
Legal entity name in website footer is 'Main St Noodles Inc © 2025', which differs from the trading name 'Main Street Poke' — not a concern for directory purposes but worth noting.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active restaurant in Whistler village with a live website, online ordering, customer reviews, and confirmed contact details. A practical meal stop for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website states 'Our selection will indulge everyone, from fish lovers, to vegans' confirming vegan options; GF status not mentioned
